title: Sunan al-Nasa'i
author: an-nasai
attributionNote: The compiler selected, arranged and in places commented on the reports; the reports themselves are attributed within each text to their transmitters. The catalogue distinguishes the compiler's work from the material compiled.
description: Ahmad ibn Shu'ayb al-Nasa'i's collection, known for the severity of its criticism of transmitters and for the care with which it distinguishes the wording of otherwise similar reports.
historicalContext: Compiled in Egypt and Damascus around the turn of the tenth century. The work survives in a recension arranged by topic; the transmission history of its editions is unusually complicated.
availabilityNote: Streamed section by section from the Hadith API at read time, Arabic beside the English translation. The host does not identify the translator. Rights are unverified; the text is streamed with attribution to the host and is not relicensed.
